spec: DESIGN.md — installations, the machine seam, save locations
description: Several named systems (#784 D62–D71): where the asked pairs name several systems the installation holds, each candidate is asked as if it had been named alone, and the question answers the shared answer — resolution unanimous, system-unanimous, entries naming no system — where every candidate gives the same one, and its empty form, ambiguous, where two differ. A candidate's own pair is set aside per place, where every candidate's statement names its own system (D70), and an entry of a shared answer asks its own questions of every candidate's entry, sharing a refusal they all give — as it stands where it names no system (D71), naming every candidate where it names the entry's system (D69) — and refusing with system-ambiguous where they differ (D66, D67).

vectors.name: retrodeck-siblings-declared-alike-answer-every-question-alike
vectors.rationale: libretro's Mega Drive name names ES-DE's genesis, megadrive and megadrivejp alike, and this catalogue declares genesis and megadrive with the same folder, extensions and entries (#784 D62, D65): every question that answers for a resolved system asks each candidate as if it had been named alone, and since they all answer the same the answer is that shared answer — resolution unanimous with both candidates listed, system-unanimous where system-ambiguous would stand, and every entry naming no system. A firmware requirement filed under genesis by the core's systemname is the core's filing, not the asked system, so it stands in both candidates' answers and in the shared one; the shared firmware answer lists its cores by core file name (#784 D63).
